INHERITANCE_RATIONALE_RULE.INADMISSIBLE: 'it worked well in that family' — historical success is NEVER a basis for inheritance

KEY_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.observation: T1_15M_PRESPEC_V1 is the CLOSEST structural sibling — same primary_scope (OPENING HOUR ONLY), same position_families (M1->M2, M2->M3, M3->M4), same grammar (position-anchored 2-bar claims only)
KEY_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.critical: but it explicitly DEFERS its outcome: sequencing = 'no 15m outcome statistic is enumerated until the T1 1H phase is sealed'
KEY_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.consequence: the nearest precedent has NOT resolved the very timing question this family faces. There is no outcome architecture to inherit for an opening-hour 2-bar claim; the daily-signal precedents (T1_OUTCOME, GANN_OUTCOME) both assume a signal completing at/after a session close.
KEY_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.warning: inheriting NEXT_SESSION_OPEN by default would import a daily-signal assumption into an intraday family without a timing argument
